checkpointRule: Return every five completed families, or every two hours, whichever comes first. This lane carries two families, so it checkpoints per family rather than holding both back.

checkpoints.note: TF-800 built to the builder contract: one official form, three pages, primary_filing. Canonical and boundary fixtures rendered and rastered, every visible write read back from the finalized bytes, all nine counters zero by the builder's own count. Not verified here.

JD-CR-202 brought to the builder contract. The family existed before this lane and could not be audited: its field map used a schema the completeness verifier refuses, and three of the participant's own facts were blank on the filing because the form prints its column headings a row above its inputs. Captions are now measured and re-checked against the pinned binary; the packet identifies its petitioner. PF12 returns two rows for two assigned families, both COMPLETED, neither self-verified.

timestampBasis: Each checkpoint time is the modification time of that family's build-status.json on the build host, which is when the build that produced it finished. An earlier revision of this file carried times estimated rather than read; they were wrong by about five hours and are corrected here.
